name: Soju
description: Clear neutral spirit, distilled or diluted — the default Korean drink.

tcm.note: Distilled liquor is the hottest drink in the Chinese materia.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna in the highest degree of madya.

histamine.note: Distilled, so lower in histamine than beer or wine — but the alcohol still blocks DAO.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. The default Korean spirit's small, high-proof glass delivers enough to produce it just as fast as a Western spirit does. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
